_comment: BP10 wave - HARVEST: fxhoudinimcp help-archive loader pattern -> H22 prose corpus, 31 workflow guides gated into retrieval with provenance, outside-in benchmark harness, plus three Jev shadow guards (rerank / harvest / bench). Serial chain by design (one Opus leg live at a time). Tiers for the three builders were chosen by JEV-ROUTE at compile. Base=master 845da18e. ARMED only on Joe word, WITH -Budget (rails turn = leg dispatch). Merge/push remain Joe words per act. Own bus (battleplan/bus/bp10), own worktree prefix (bp10-*). JEV-EDGE and JEV-DRIFT run in SHADOW.

legs.name: M3: outside-in benchmark harness (SYNAPSE vs fxhoudinimcp, isolated hython per arm) + JEV-BENCH verifier + prompt leak check; plumbing proven on 1 prompt, G5 held for Joe
legs.note: BATTLEPLAN harness/battleplan/notes/HARVEST_SPEC.md :: sec. 'Target 3: outside-in benchmark'; sec. 'Gates' G5; JEV_HARVEST_BLUEPRINT sec. 'Site 3'. Self-cap: 30 turns (progress every 5). Permission fence: scoped `git add` + `git commit` only; push/merge/checkout/reset denied; use `cd <path> && git status --short`, never `git -C`. Commit code BEFORE the receipt; the receipt is your final write. Budget discipline: run /token-saver first and keep to it - Select-String / grep for symbols, read 40-line windows around cited lines, never whole files; the two source docs are your brief, read them ONCE in full at the start and then only grep them. Houdini GUI is NOT available to you: anything that needs a live panel is UNKNOWN, never a pass. hython IS available at `C:\Program Files\Side Effects Software\Houdini 22.0.400\bin\hython.exe` (22.0.400) for headless gates. Minimal diff: touch only the files in `touches`. House rule: no number enters a document without a producer path beside it. Every UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN - never a pass, never a 0. Read HARVEST_SPEC.md sec. 'Target 3' first: the fairness rules are the contract and are written down BEFORE the first run. Isolation is the whole design: each arm gets its own hython, own port (pin both explicitly: SYNAPSE 9999, fxhoudinimcp 8100), own scene copy. fxhoudinimcp installs via `pip install fxhoudinimcp` into a SEPARATE venv + its Houdini package file pointed at a scratch packages dir - never into SYNAPSE's env, never vendored. The full G5 run (24 prompts x 2 arms x 3 runs) is SPEND and is Joe's word: this leg runs exactly ONE prompt per arm on the empty scene to prove the plumbing and STOPS. Jev invariants (JEV_BLUEPRINT.md sec. 4 + adapter.py): questions are DATA in harness/jev/questions.json; code owns every decision; fail closed (no key / timeout -> the pre-Jev output, ledgered as fallback, no fabricated probability); every call ledgered under harness/jev/ledger/bp10.<guard>.jsonl; nothing under python/synapse/ imports harness/jev (pinned by tests/test_jev_product_boundary.py). A Jev answer never promotes a chunk, never names a model, never grants consent.
